description:
pattern     case-stack / portfolio
surface     dark
kit         ambient cyan orb behind alternate project showcases
form        Columns 1–12 arrange 4 comprehensive case study rows, each structured with a high-fidelity system preview card, project title, role badge, technology pills, and clear measurable outcome text. On mobile, each case study stacks the preview screenshot over the explanatory brief.
copy
  eyebrow      SYSTEMS & SOLUTIONS
  heading      Featured Projects
  proj-1-title Vavuniya Campus Asset & Resource Tracker
  proj-1-role  Lead Full-Stack Developer
  proj-1-tech  React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Tailwind CSS
  proj-1-res   Reduced departmental equipment allocation tracking latency by 65% and eliminated duplicate physical paper logs across two faculty facilities.
  proj-2-title Automated Student Academic Advising Portal
  proj-2-role  System Architect & Frontend Engineer
  proj-2-tech  Next.js, TypeScript, Python FastAPI, MongoDB
  proj-2-res   Enabled over 800 undergraduates to dynamically simulate degree module paths and monitor prerequisite fulfillment with real-time academic validation.
  proj-3-title IoT Agricultural Telemetry & Monitoring Node
  proj-3-role  Embedded Systems & Backend Developer
  proj-3-tech  ESP32, MQTT, Express, InfluxDB, Grafana
  proj-3-res   Deployed solar-powered sensory hardware delivering microclimate soil and moisture readings at 30-second intervals for faculty experimental crops.
  proj-4-title Distributed Cloud Examination Verification Engine
  proj-4-role  DevOps & Security Engineer
  proj-4-tech  Go, AWS Lambda, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions
  proj-4-res   Architected resilient verification pipelines handling 1,200 concurrent student submissions without dropped transactions during semester final exams.
image       16:10; set of 4 interface screenshots and system architecture previews showing asset dashboards, academic schedule grids, IoT sensor telemetry charts, and high-throughput server consoles; placed in preview container of each project, treatment documentary; alt: Software project case studies built by Tharindu Perera
motion      Project rows reveal alternately with subtle slide-in at 120ms; technology pills stagger at 40ms intervals upon entering viewport.
plan check  heading placed; set of 4 project case studies placed; each with screenshot, project title, role, technologies used, and result/outcome text placed.
layout_description: Four vertical stacked case study blocks with alternating image-left and image-right grid splits.
kit: ambient cyan orb behind alternate project showcases
